consequence.statement: RBAC policies referencing Dex `sub` claim values will no longer grant access after upgrade to 3.0.0 unless updated to use `federated_claims.user_id` values instead.
consequence.remediation: Decode current `sub` claims in RBAC policies to obtain the corresponding `user_id` value, and update policy subjects to reference the new `federated_claims.user_id` claim. Upgrade CLI clients to obtain tokens with the new claims.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 changes the Dex SSO RBAC subject from the `sub` claim to `federated_claims.user_id`; existing RBAC policies using the `sub` claim value must be updated to use the new claim value.
